title: Keep project ownership separate
when: When the requested outcome touches multiple project repositories or changes a reusable producer contract.
need: Each project retains its own item and lane; companion items express real cross-project code changes. The configured release-time exact-pair gate owns consumer compatibility proof, not a separate build before item merge or a verification-only companion. Related does not automatically mean shared deployment. An explicitly requested consumer case uses the full producer commit its gate actually pushed after any rebase; a local pre-gate SHA may never be published.
surface: Intake cross-project handling; project/document steering scope
gap: JOURNEYS 14 says link them but lacks a beginner procedure. Review question: should its guide distinguish shared context, dependent work and shared delivery as separate needs?
